aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food trucks and mobile caterers: online orders, collection times and fewer repeated questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.

aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile caterers, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders running smoothly and reduce the time spent dealing with repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software available to them is designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses actually operate.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started with one simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory that helps people discover food trucks coming to their area, I spent more time understanding the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike ordinary restaurants, food trucks are always moving, trading at different locations and serving customers in constantly changing conditions.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once, and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers cannot choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the van — and the card terminal you already use to take payment.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume you have a fixed address, stable wifi and the same operating hours every week. You, though, are somewhere new every week, at different times, with weak or no mobile coverage. HatchGrab was built for that situation.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online ordering is paused automatically so customers cannot place orders you do not see. Carry on taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We will fill in your dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order early and choose a collection time. Shorter queues, and food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Built for food trucks, not restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp is answered while you drive to the trading spot or are busy at the grill, using your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp will be answered while you drive to the trading spot or are busy at the grill. Messenger and Instagram will follow.
landing.final.lede: Upload a photo or screenshot of your menu and we will turn it into a working ordering page for you to try in under 60 seconds. Your items, your prices. No sign-up, no card, nothing to install. Look first, then decide.

comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.whatQ: What is a food truck ordering system?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the food truck: they choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or on collection, and the order appears in your kitchen. A POS system or card terminal, on the other hand, takes payment at the food truck. The two complement each other.
comparison.faq.costQ: How much does HatchGrab cost in {country}?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments are also charged Stripe's fees: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.termQ: Is there a minimum contract period?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum period and no notice period. You can cancel any time; the fee is billed monthly in advance, and you keep access until the end of the month you have paid for.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Can it be used with changing locations?
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up a weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and the day you are there.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does this system prevent my kitchen being overloaded?
comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times your kitchen can really manage. The system calculates from each dish's preparation time and how many you prepare at once.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a cash register certified to meet the tax rules?
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a POS system and is not a cash register certified to meet the tax rules. How to record online orders in your POS system is a question for your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay on collection at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported for now.
